title: The Sun and the Moon
moral: When a brother and sister care for each other and stick together, they can get through even the scariest night.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md §3-4). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 voice_script_en.json 의 en 그대로, trim 은 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

lines.text: 옛날 옛날 산골 오막살이에 엄마와 오누이가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, a mom and her two children, a brother and a sister, lived in a little hut in the mountains.
segs: Once upon a time, a mom and her two children, a brother and a sister, lived in a little hut in the mountains.

lines.text: 오빠는 씩씩하고, 동생은 까르르 웃음이 많았지요.
lines.en: The brother was brave, and the little sister giggled all day long.
segs: The brother was brave, and the little sister giggled all day long.

lines.text: 아침 해가 반짝 뜨자, 엄마는 부지런히 일하러 나갈 채비를 했어요.
lines.en: When the morning sun came up bright and shiny, Mom got ready to go to work.
segs: When the morning sun came up bright and shiny, Mom got ready to go to work.

lines.text: "다녀오세요!" 오누이는 손을 흔들흔들 인사했어요.
lines.en: "Take care, Mom!" The brother and sister waved and waved goodbye.
segs: The brother and sister waved and waved goodbye.

lines.text: 엄마가 말했어요. "문 꼭 잠그고 엄마 기다려라~"
lines.en: Mom said, "Lock the door tight and wait for Mom~"
segs: Lock the door tight and wait for Mom~

lines.text: 엄마가 떠나자 오누이는 문을 꼭 잠갔어요.
lines.en: After Mom left, the children locked the door tight.
segs: After Mom left, the children locked the door tight.

lines.text: 엄마는 산길을 지나 부잣집 부엌에 도착했어요.
lines.en: Mom walked along the mountain path to the rich family’s kitchen.
segs: Mom walked along the mountain path to the rich family’s kitchen.

lines.text: 엄마는 부잣집에서 하루 종일 부지런히 일했어요.
lines.en: Mom worked hard all day long at the rich family's house.
segs: Mom worked hard all day long at the rich family's house.

lines.text: 싹싹 쌀을 씻고, 활활 불을 때고, 모락모락 떡을 쪘지요.
lines.en: Swish, swish, she washed the rice. Crackle, crackle, she fed the fire. And puff, puff, she steamed the rice cakes.
segs: Swish, swish, she washed the rice. Crackle, crackle, she fed the fire. And puff, puff, she steamed the rice cakes.

lines.text: 저녁이 되자 부잣집 주인이 말랑말랑한 떡을 한 아름 내주었어요.
lines.en: When evening came, the lady of the house gave her a big armful of soft, squishy rice cakes.
segs: When evening came, the lady of the house gave her a big armful of soft, squishy rice cakes.

lines.text: "수고했어요. 떡 가져가요!"
lines.from: "수고했어요. 떡 가져가요!" 떡을 하나씩 톡! 세면서 담아요.
lines.en: Thank you for your hard work. Take these rice cakes!
segs: Thank you for your hard work. Take these rice cakes!

lines.text: 떡을 바구니 가득 받았어요! "우리 아이들이 좋아하겠다!" 엄마는 서둘러 집으로 떠났어요.
lines.en: The basket is full of rice cakes! "The children will love these!" Mom hurried off toward home.
segs: The basket is full of rice cakes!

lines.text: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 지고 있어요. 엄마가 첫째 고개를 넘어요.
lines.en: The sun is slowly setting. Mom is crossing the first hill.
segs: The sun is slowly setting. Mom is crossing the first hill.

lines.text: 그때 바위 뒤에서 무언가 불쑥! 커다란 호랑이였어요.
lines.en: Then, from behind the rock, something popped out! It was a great big tiger.
segs: Then, from behind the rock, something popped out! It was a great big tiger.

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 한 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me one rice cake, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me one rice cake, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 엄마는 덜덜 떨리는 손으로 떡 한 개를 꺼내 주었어요.
lines.en: With a hand shaking and trembling, Mom took out one rice cake and gave it to the tiger.
segs: With a hand shaking and trembling, Mom took out one rice cake and gave it to the tiger.

lines.text: 호랑이는 떡 한 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: The tiger gulps down one rice cake! What a round tummy!
segs: The tiger gulps down one rice cake! What a round tummy!

lines.text: 하늘이 붉어졌어요. 엄마가 둘째 고개를 넘어요.
lines.en: The sky has turned red. Mom is crossing the second hill.
segs: The sky has turned red. Mom is crossing the second hill.

lines.text: 그런데 또 바위 뒤에서 불쑥! 아까 그 호랑이가 또 나타났어요.
lines.en: But then, from behind another rock, pop! The very same tiger appeared again.
segs: But then, from behind another rock, pop! The very same tiger appeared again.

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 두 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me two rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me two rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 엄마는 바구니에서 떡 두 개를 주섬주섬 꺼내 주었어요.
lines.en: Mom fumbled in the basket and took out two rice cakes for the tiger.
segs: Mom fumbled in the basket and took out two rice cakes for the tiger.

lines.text: 떡 두 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Two more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.
segs: Gulp! Two more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 깜깜한 밤이 되었어요. 엄마가 셋째 고개를 넘어요.
lines.en: It is a dark, dark night. Mom is crossing the third hill.
segs: It is a dark, dark night. Mom is crossing the third hill.

lines.text: 바위 뒤에서 또다시 불쑥! 호랑이 눈이 어둠 속에서 번쩍번쩍 빛났어요.
lines.en: From behind the rock, pop, there it was again! The tiger's eyes flashed and glowed in the dark.
segs: From behind the rock, pop, there it was again! The tiger's eyes flashed and glowed in the dark.

lines.text: "어흥! 남은 떡 몽땅 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me all the leftover rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me all the leftover rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 남은 떡을 몽땅 꿀꺽! 배가 빵빵해졌어요!
lines.en: The tiger gulps down all the leftover rice cakes! What a big, round tummy!
segs: The tiger gulps down all the leftover rice cakes! What a big, round tummy!

lines.text: 엄마는 텅 빈 바구니를 꼭 끌어안고 부들부들 떨었어요.
lines.en: Mom hugged the empty basket tight, shivering and shaking.
segs: Mom hugged the empty basket tight, shivering and shaking.

lines.text: 떡이 다 떨어지자 호랑이가 말했어요. "떡이 없으면 너를 잡아먹어야지!"
lines.en: When the rice cakes were all gone, the tiger said, "No more rice cakes? Then I'll have to eat you!"
segs: When the rice cakes were all gone, the tiger said,
No more rice cakes? Then I'll have to eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이는 엄마를 꿀꺽 잡아먹고 말았어요.
lines.en: The tiger ate Mom up with one big gulp.
segs: The tiger ate Mom up with one big gulp.

lines.text: 호랑이는 엄마 옷을 입고, 오누이가 기다리는 집으로 갔어요.
lines.en: The tiger put on Mom's clothes and went to the house where the brother and sister were waiting.
segs: The tiger put on Mom's clothes and went to the house where the brother and sister were waiting.

lines.text: 집에서는 오누이가 엄마를 기다리고 있었어요. 등잔불이 가물가물 흔들렸지요.
lines.en: Back at home, the brother and sister were waiting for Mom. The little lamp flickered and flickered.
segs: Back at home, the brother and sister were waiting for Mom. The little lamp flickered and flickered.

lines.text: 문밖에는 엄마 옷을 입은 호랑이가 서 있었어요.
lines.en: Outside stood the tiger, wearing Mom’s clothes.
segs: Outside stood the tiger, wearing Mom’s clothes.

lines.text: 똑똑똑. "얘들아~ 엄마 왔다. 문 열어라~" 걸걸한 목소리예요.
lines.en: Knock, knock, knock. "Kids~ Mom's home. Open the door~" The voice is rough and raspy.
segs: Kids~ Mom's home. Open the door~
The voice is rough and raspy.

lines.text: 오누이는 고개를 갸웃갸웃했어요. 엄마 목소리는 다정하고 부드러운데 말이에요.
lines.en: The children tilted their heads this way and that. Mom's voice was always warm and soft.
segs: The children tilted their heads this way and that. Mom's voice was always warm and soft.

lines.text: 오빠가 말했어요. "우리 엄마 목소리가 아니에요! 손을 보여 주세요!"
lines.en: The brother said, "That is not our mom's voice! Show us your hand!"
segs: That is not our mom's voice! Show us your hand!

lines.text: 문틈으로 손 하나가 쑥 들어왔어요.
lines.en: A hand slid in through the crack in the door.
segs: A hand slid in through the crack in the door.

lines.text: 그런데 문틈으로 들어온 손은… 하얀 밀가루 사이로 발톱이 쏙! 엄마 손이 아니에요!
lines.en: But the hand through the crack in the door... Sharp claws poke out from the white flour! That is not Mom's hand!
segs: But the hand through the crack in the door... Sharp claws poke out from the white flour! That is not Mom's hand!

lines.text: 문밖에 누가 있는지 보고 싶어요.
lines.from: 문밖에 누가 있는지 보고 싶어요. 창호지를 손가락으로 콕 뚫어 볼까요?
lines.en: We want to see who is outside.
segs: We want to see who is outside.

lines.text: 오빠가 창호지에 손가락으로 살며시 콕, 구멍을 냈어요.
lines.en: The brother quietly poked, poke, a little hole in the paper door with his finger.
segs: The brother quietly poked, poke, a little hole in the paper door with his finger.

lines.text: 구멍 너머에 커다랗고 동그란 눈이 깜빡깜빡! 호랑이예요!
lines.en: Through the hole, a big round eye blinks and blinks! It is the tiger!
segs: Through the hole, a big round eye blinks and blinks! It is the tiger!

lines.text: 오빠가 속삭였어요. "쉿, 뒷문으로 살금살금 도망가자!"
lines.en: The brother whispered, "Shh, let's tiptoe out the back door!"
segs: Shh, let's tiptoe out the back door!

lines.text: 깜깜한 뒷마당에 오누이가 발을 살금살금 내디뎠어요.
lines.en: The children stepped softly into the dark backyard.
segs: The children stepped softly into the dark backyard.

lines.text: 오누이는 뒷문으로 살금살금 나왔어요.
lines.en: The children tiptoed out the back door.
segs: The children tiptoed out the back door.

lines.text: 앗, 호랑이가 오는 소리! 커다란 장독 뒤로 숨어요!
lines.en: Oh! The tiger is coming! Hide behind the big jar!
segs: Oh! The tiger is coming! Hide behind the big jar!

lines.text: 오누이는 숨을 꼭 참고 장독 뒤에 납작 붙어 있었어요. 가슴이 콩닥콩닥 뛰었지요.
lines.en: The children held their breath and pressed flat against the big jar. Their hearts went thump, thump, thump.
segs: The children held their breath and pressed flat against the big jar. Their hearts went thump, thump, thump.

lines.text: "오빠, 무서워…" 동생이 덜덜 떨며 오빠 손을 꼭 잡았어요.
lines.en: "Big brother, I am scared..." The sister trembled and held her brother's hand tight.
segs: The sister trembled and held her brother's hand tight.

lines.text: "얘들아~ 어디 갔니?" 호랑이는 두리번두리번하다가 집 쪽으로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: "Kids~ where did you go?" The tiger looked around and around, then went back toward the house.
segs: The tiger looked around and around, then went back toward the house.

lines.text: 휴~ 이제 우물가 큰 나무로 달려가요!
lines.en: Phew! Now run to the big tree by the well!
segs: Phew! Now run to the big tree by the well!

lines.text: 오누이는 장독 뒤를 떠나 우물가에 다다랐어요.
lines.en: The children left the jars and reached the well.
segs: The children left the jars and reached the well.

lines.text: 우물가에 커다란 나무가 있어요.
lines.from: 우물가에 커다란 나무가 있어요. 톡! 영차영차 올라가요.
lines.en: There is a big tree by the well.
segs: There is a big tree by the well.

lines.text: 오누이는 영차영차, 나무를 타고 쑥쑥 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho, up and up the tree the brother and sister climbed.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho, up and up the tree the brother and sister climbed.

lines.text: 오누이는 나무 꼭대기까지 올라갔어요!
lines.en: The brother and sister climbed all the way to the top of the tree!
segs: The brother and sister climbed all the way to the top of the tree!

lines.text: 호랑이가 뒷마당에 왔어요. "옳지! 우물 속에 숨었구나!"
lines.en: The tiger came to the backyard. "Aha! They are hiding in the well!"
segs: The tiger came to the backyard.
Aha! They are hiding in the well!

lines.text: 호랑이가 우물 속을 들여다봤어요. 우물 물에 오누이 얼굴이 비쳤거든요!
lines.en: The tiger peeked into the well. The brother's and sister's faces were shining in the water!
segs: The tiger peeked into the well. The brother's and sister's faces were shining in the water!

lines.text: "두레박으로 건져야지~" 영차!
lines.en: "I'll scoop them up with the bucket~" Heave-ho!
segs: I'll scoop them up with the bucket~ Heave-ho!

lines.text: 첨벙! 두레박에는 물만 가득.
lines.from: 첨벙! 두레박에는 물만 가득. 우물 속 오누이 얼굴을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Splash! The bucket is full of just water.
segs: Splash! The bucket is full of just water.

lines.text: 나무 위에서 오누이가 그만 킥킥 웃고 말았어요.
lines.en: Up in the tree, the brother and sister couldn't help giggling.
segs: Up in the tree, the brother and sister couldn't help giggling.

lines.text: "어? 위에서 웃음소리가?" 호랑이가 고개를 번쩍 들었어요.
lines.en: "Huh? A laugh from up above?" The tiger looked up with a jerk.
segs: Huh? A laugh from up above?
The tiger looked up with a jerk.

lines.text: 호랑이가 올려다보며 물었어요. "얘들아, 거기 어떻게 올라갔니?"
lines.en: The tiger looked up and asked, "Kids, how did you climb up there?"
segs: The tiger looked up and asked,
Kids, how did you climb up there?

lines.text: 오빠가 꾀를 냈어요. "참기름 바르고 올라왔지!"
lines.en: The brother thought up a trick. "We rubbed on sesame oil and climbed up!"
segs: The brother thought up a trick.
We rubbed on sesame oil and climbed up!

lines.text: 호랑이는 참기름을 나무에 척척 바르고 영차, 올라가려 했어요.
lines.en: The tiger slapped sesame oil all over the tree and, heave-ho, tried to climb.
segs: The tiger slapped sesame oil all over the tree and, heave-ho, tried to climb.

lines.text: 미끌 쭈르륵! 호랑이는 자꾸자꾸 미끄러졌어요.
lines.en: Slip, slide! The tiger kept on slipping down.
segs: Slip, slide! The tiger kept on slipping down.

lines.text: 그때 동생이 깔깔 웃으며 말해 버렸어요. "도끼로 콕콕 찍고 올라왔지~"
lines.en: Then the sister burst out laughing and blurted, "We chopped with an axe, chop, chop, and climbed up~"
segs: Then the sister burst out laughing and blurted,
We chopped with an axe, chop, chop, and climbed up~

lines.text: 오빠가 "쉿!" 했지만… 벌써 들어 버렸어요!
lines.en: The brother said "Shh!" but... it was too late! The tiger had already heard!
segs: but... it was too late! The tiger had already heard!

lines.text: 호랑이가 도끼로 콕콕 찍으며 올라와요! 오누이는 덜덜 떨었어요.
lines.en: The tiger is climbing up, chopping with an axe! The brother and sister shivered and shook.
segs: The tiger is climbing up, chopping with an axe! The brother and sister shivered and shook.

lines.text: 나무 꼭대기에서 오누이는 서로 꼭 붙어 있었어요.
lines.en: At the top of the tree, the children huddled close.
segs: At the top of the tree, the children huddled close.

lines.text: 호랑이가 점점 가까이 올라와요. 오누이는 두 손을 모았어요.
lines.en: The tiger is getting closer and closer. The brother and sister put their hands together.
segs: The tiger is getting closer and closer. The brother and sister put their hands together.

lines.text: "하늘님, 튼튼한 동아줄을 내려 주세요!"
lines.en: "Dear Sky, please send down a strong rope!"
segs: Dear Sky, please send down a strong rope!

lines.text: 그러자 하늘에서 굵은 동아줄이 스르르 내려왔어요!
lines.en: And then, a thick rope came slowly down from the sky!
segs: And then, a thick rope came slowly down from the sky!

lines.text: 반짝이는 굵은 줄이 튼튼한 동아줄이에요!
lines.en: The thick, shiny rope is the strong rope!
segs: The thick, shiny rope is the strong rope!

lines.text: 오누이는 줄을 꼭 붙잡고 대롱대롱 매달렸어요.
lines.en: The brother and sister grabbed the rope tight and dangled, swinging to and fro.
segs: The brother and sister grabbed the rope tight and dangled, swinging to and fro.

lines.text: 줄을 꼭 잡고, 영차영차 올라가요!
lines.en: Hold on tight and climb, heave-ho!
segs: Hold on tight and climb, heave-ho!

lines.text: 구름을 뚫고 쑥쑥!
lines.en: Up through the clouds, whoosh, whoosh!
segs: Up through the clouds, whoosh, whoosh!

lines.text: 구름을 여섯 겹이나 뚫고, 오누이는 하늘 나라에 닿았어요!
lines.en: Through six layers of clouds, the brother and sister reached the land in the sky!
segs: Through six layers of clouds, the brother and sister reached the land in the sky!

lines.text: 오누이가 떠난 나무에 호랑이만 남았어요.
lines.en: The children were gone, and the tiger was left in the tree.
segs: The children were gone, and the tiger was left in the tree.

lines.text: 호랑이도 하늘에 빌었어요. 그랬더니 낡은 줄이 스르르 내려왔어요.
lines.en: The tiger prayed to the sky too. And an old rope slid slowly down.
segs: The tiger prayed to the sky too. And an old rope slid slowly down.

lines.text: "어흥, 나도 올라가야지!" 호랑이는 신이 나서 줄을 덥석 잡았어요.
lines.en: "Roar! I am going up too!" The tiger was thrilled and grabbed the rope.
segs: Roar! I am going up too!
The tiger was thrilled and grabbed the rope.

lines.text: 호랑이는 낡은 줄을 타고 영차영차 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho, the tiger climbed up the old rope.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho, the tiger climbed up the old rope.

lines.text: 삐걱삐걱… 뚝! 줄이 그만 끊어지고 말았어요.
lines.en: Creak, creak... Snap! The old rope broke right in two.
segs: Creak, creak... Snap! The old rope broke right in two.

lines.text: 호랑이는 수수밭에 쿵! 하고 떨어졌어요.
lines.en: The tiger tumbled down into the sorghum field with a great big thump!
segs: The tiger tumbled down into the sorghum field with a great big thump!

lines.text: "아이코 내 엉덩이! 아이코 내 머리!" 호랑이 머리에 동그란 혹이 났어요.
lines.en: "Ouch, my bottom! Ouch, my head!" A round bump popped up on the tiger's head.
segs: Ouch, my bottom! Ouch, my head!
A round bump popped up on the tiger's head.

lines.text: 호랑이는 혹을 달고 산속으로 줄행랑! 다시는 오지 않았대요.
lines.en: The tiger ran off into the mountains with a bump on its head! And they say it never came back again.
segs: The tiger ran off into the mountains with a bump on its head! And they say it never came back again.

lines.text: 그동안 오누이는 하늘 나라에서 무사히 함께 있었어요.
lines.en: Meanwhile, the children were safe together in the sky.
segs: Meanwhile, the children were safe together in the sky.

lines.text: 하늘 나라에 간 오빠는 해님이, 동생은 달님이 되었어요.
lines.en: In the land in the sky, the brother became the Sun, and the sister became the Moon.
segs: In the land in the sky, the brother became the Sun, and the sister became the Moon.

lines.text: 오빠는 낮에 쨍쨍 환하게, 동생은 밤에 은은하게 세상을 비추었지요.
lines.en: The brother shone bright and blazing in the day, and the sister glowed softly at night.
segs: The brother shone bright and blazing in the day, and the sister glowed softly at night.

lines.text: 동생이 말했어요. "오빠, 나는 밤이 무서워요."
lines.en: The sister said, "Big brother, I am scared of the night."
segs: Big brother, I am scared of the night.

lines.text: "그럼 우리 바꾸자!"
lines.en: "Then let's switch!"

lines.text: 오빠는 싱긋 웃으며 기꺼이 자리를 바꿔 주었어요.
lines.en: The brother smiled a big smile and gladly switched places.
segs: The brother smiled a big smile and gladly switched places.

lines.text: 그래서 동생은 해님, 오빠는 달님이 되었답니다.
lines.en: So the sister became the Sun, and the brother became the Moon.
segs: So the sister became the Sun, and the brother became the Moon.

lines.text: 해님 달님은 오늘도 하늘에서 우리를 환하게 비춰 준답니다.
lines.en: Even today, the Sun and the Moon shine brightly on us from the sky.
segs: Even today, the Sun and the Moon shine brightly on us from the sky.

lines.text: 오누이처럼 서로 아끼고 힘을 모으면 무서운 일도 이겨 낼 수 있답니다.
lines.en: When a brother and sister care for each other and stick together, they can get through even the scariest night.
segs: When a brother and sister care for each other and stick together, they can get through even the scariest night.
